name: srow
description: A ruled row of the record: the 58px time column, then the content. When it holds the entry actions, its body lays them out in a gutter at the right of the text; below 1000px of container the tools drop under the text, which takes the full width. Index pages (the motion index) use it without the time column.

bareTime.description: The time as text (18's generic state pages draw it so); the runtime's entry template keeps the time element.

time.description: The time ("09:20"), a <time> element; absent on index pages, where the row has no column.

datetime.description: The time's machine-readable value for the <time> element ("2026-08-09T09:20").

children.description: The body: the entry's prose, its entry actions and its mark; on index pages a section head, a lede and links.

places.after: a mark after the words: --s4 above
places.span: the entry editor, the delete confirmation, a state message: the full grid, --s4 above
places.tools: the entry's actions (entry-actions, its tools form): the row's grid gives them the second column

states.hover: n/a: the row has no hover of its own; its entry actions reveal themselves (their module reads the row)
states.focus-visible: n/a: the row is not focusable; its controls carry the focus ring
states.active: n/a: the row is not a control
states.disabled: n/a: the row is not a control
states.loading: n/a: a row is written with the page; saving is reported by a notice
states.error: n/a: an error is a notice beside the row, not a state of it
states.empty: n/a: a day with no entries shows the empty line, not an empty row

a11y.role: none (a div); the time is a <time> element
a11y.keyboard: none of its own; Tab reaches its entry actions
a11y.labels: the entry actions carry their own group label

responsive.1000: below 1000px of container, a row with entry actions drops the tools under the text; the text takes the full width

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css C2 (.srow, its .tcol and .ccol, and the entry action gutter).
Declares datetime for the <time> element; the render writes it.
Option bareTime: the time as text in its column (the generic state pages' entry rows), not a time element. Pages round 4b.
No longer sets --aj-c-entry-actions-trigger-max: entry-actions 0.3.0 has no memory dropdown.
Sets --aj-c-entry-actions-trigger-max again: entry-actions 0.4.0 has its memory dropdown back (on entries kept out).

hooks.data-entry-key: The entry key of a row the prototype tracks (its model); the runtime writes it and finds the row by it.
